findings.text: The restart path's deferral call passes pid=None but not owner_checked, so _foreign_live_follower answers with _pair_is_owners(session, owner_checked=False) for a child that reached this line only because it was the owner's: a marked child for an earlier session that exits can still defer forever to a live duplicate started by another owner's host, which is the deferral defect the section set out to close for the current session's pairs.

_pair_is_owners returns True whenever _calling_session resolves nothing, so a host that cannot name the session it serves restarts every child it holds, including an unmarked foreign one; the goal's 'only its own session's followers' therefore does not hold for a host launched with its harness environment stripped, which is the class of host the incident's fifteen-day-old process belonged to.

All five negative-control logs name revision aebf721d7e with their mutation, but b3c2e8823c changed _pair_is_owners after they were recorded and that predicate is what the mark-only mutation exercises, so the landed predicate carries no recorded control; the five cases still pass at the landed head, so the gap is in the control record rather than in the guard.
